req.title: OpenAPI includes task schemas
req.statement: The system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-040 requires that the OpenAPI spec (GET /openapi.json) documents three specific schemas: TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task. Tests must verify: (1) the endpoint returns HTTP 200 and all three schema names appear in the 'components/schemas' section (positive/EP), (2) a schema name that should NOT exist is absent (negative/NEG to catch false-positive mutations), and (3) each schema contains the exact field names defined in app/schemas.py (boundary/BVA to catch constant/name mutations). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact schema keys, and exact field membership — not just existence.

tests.name: test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas
trace: R-TASK-040: system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "TaskCreate" in schemas
    assert "TaskUpdate" in schemas
    assert "Task" in schemas

test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas()

trace: R-TASK-040: Expected outcomes: HTTP 2xx response; Error pathways: HTTP 4xx on client error
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_openapi_endpoint_returns_200_not_4xx():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 422
    assert r.status_code != 500
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert "openapi" in body
    assert body["openapi"].startswith("3.")

test_openapi_endpoint_returns_200_not_4xx()

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_openapi_task_schema_id_is_required():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    task_schema = schemas["Task"]
    required = task_schema.get("required", [])
    assert "id" in required
    assert "created_at" in required
    assert "title" in required
